blocks.title: Antivirus software
blocks.text: Antivirus software computer ko spyware jaise nuqsan deh programs se bachata hai.
File download karne par antivirus chhupe khatre jaanchta hai; mehfooz file aam tareeqe se khulti, jabke nuqsan deh file par khabardari aati aur rok diya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Antivirus software ko update rakhna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Naya malware musalsal aata hai; updates antivirus ko naye khatre pehchanna sikhate hain.

items: Antivirus files jaanchta aur nuqsan deh programs rokta hai; update rakhein.
